prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop web app layout decision comp, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity north-star mockup for the Spectro unified event explorer using the “Signal Matrix” structure. This is an operational interface, not a marketing page.
Reference image: carry over only Spectro’s existing chrome, cool daylight palette, Avenir-like humanist typography, compact monospaced telemetry, hairline borders, restrained ultraviolet/cyan signal accents, white instrument surfaces, and gently rounded 12–16px containers. Do not carry over the foundation page’s hero copy, signal-path diagram, or split landing-page composition.
Structure: quiet top navigation and one compact command row for project prj_checkout, production, and Last 30 minutes. The upper half is a multi-channel time matrix: labeled horizontal rows for Error, Performance, Network, Interaction, Page, and Custom; a shared time scale; sparse event nodes and short ticks aligned by timestamp so causal clusters are obvious. One selected vertical ultraviolet cursor crosses every channel. The lower half contains a dense event ledger on the left and a selected event context readout on the right, both aligned to the selected cursor. Filters sit along the matrix edge, not in separate cards.
Content: clearly label all data as illustrative. Use runtime_error, web_vital_lcp, fetch_request, element_click, page_view, checkout_completed, session/page/release context, and a selected runtime_error at /checkout.
Style: quiet precision signal analyzer in cool daylight, 90% neutral and 10% signal; flat surfaces and hairline structure; nodes glow only when selected or meaningfully active.
Constraints: readable dense UI, familiar controls, no gradients as decoration, no black dashboard, no KPI cards, no floating glass panels, no fabricated customers or production metrics, no watermark. Do not turn the matrix into a generic analytics chart; it must support selecting and inspecting individual events.
